analysis: Artifact-only ADDRESS CAPACITY V1 retrospective exploratory analysis
unit: Whole paired world, averaging both value lives; both CANON and EXPAND stay in the same held-out fold
primary_outcome: Existing DIRECT OLD_final payload_exact, nonempty values
baseline_predictors: existing DIRECT OLD_rest1 payload_exact before NEW
enhanced_predictors: mean pre-value weighted_old_new_overlap across all nine slots and two sides
feature_selection: Exactly this one geometry scalar, not selected from outcomes; no alternatives searched
fit: Unregularized small OLS, numpy.linalg.lstsq, training-fold feature scaling; no tuning; unclipped prediction
validation: Eight leave-whole-world-out folds; report RMSE and MAE and fold errors; retrospectively exploratory, not independent scientific confirmation
other_reporting: Paired final OLD/NEW payload and complete scores, existing passive NEW OLD_S_NEW scores, fixture self/cross influence and resource costs; no additional fitted endpoints
leakage_exclusions: No final margins, no final geometry, no target-label-derived geometry; assessment answers and final scores never enter predictors
constraints: Read immutable Git blobs in memory only; no raw arrays, checkpoints, zip restoration, native imports, teaching, trajectory replay, head fitting, candidate training, source/pointer edits, or push
goal_boundary: E1 taught random associations only. Unseen-addition generalization remains untested by this contrast.
